name: jyu_slide_key
desc: Same character, same colors and cream pattern, facing left. The head and face stay the same as now: the same thick angular black eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and closed mouth. New pose: a head-first slide, he is lying flat on his big belly on the ground, the body stretched out horizontally with the head at the left, both arms stretched straight forward to the left past the head, the legs stretched out behind to the right, the head lifted a little, sliding on a slick of his own thick paint, paint smeared and splashing up around the belly. Same outline and pixel art style.
